title: Bodies of climbers killed in avalanche retrieved from Broad Peak
english: Search teams have successfully recovered the bodies of famous climber Nirmal Purja and his teammates from Broad Peak in Pakistan. The group tragically lost their lives after being struck by an avalanche on the world's 12th-highest mountain. Recovery efforts were focused on retrieving the remains following the fatal incident.
amharic: የነፍስ አድን ቡድኖች በፓኪስታን በሚገኘው ብሮድ ፒክ ተራራ ላይ በአደጋ ምክንያት ህይወታቸው ያለፈውን ታዋቂው ተራራ መውጣት ባለሙያ ኒርማል ፑርጃን እና የቡድን አባላቱን አስከሬን አግኝተዋል። ተራራ ወጣዮቹ በዓለም ላይ አስራ ሁለተኛው ረጅሙ ተራራ በሆነው ስፍራ በደረሰ የበረዶ ናዳ ህይወታቸው አልፏል። አስከሬኖቹ በከፍተኛ ጥረት ከስፍራው ተገኝተዋል።
oromo: Gareen barbaachaafi oolchituu balaa, reeffa baattuu gaaraa beekamaa Nirmal Purjaafi miseensota garee isaa gaara Paakistaan keessatti argamu Broad Peak irratti argataniiru. Gareen kun gaara adunyaa irratti sadarkaa 12ffaa qabu kana irratti yeroo cabbiin gadi bu'u (avalanche) lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Reeffa isaanii baasuuf carraaqqii cimaa booda milkaa'aniiru.

title: Mexico deploys troops to secure avocado region after US halts imports
english: Mexico has sent over 1,500 soldiers to its primary avocado-growing region to restore safety and order. This action follows a decision by the United States to stop inspecting avocado imports due to rising security threats in the area. The suspension of trade has halted shipments, putting both the local economy and thousands of jobs at risk.
amharic: ሜክሲኮ በአካባቢው እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የጸጥታ ችግር ተከትሎ ዋናው የአቮካዶ ምርት በሚካሄድበት ክልል ከ1,500 በላይ ወታደሮችን አሰማራለች። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው አሜሪካ በጸጥታ ስጋት ምክንያት የአቮካዶ ምርቶችን ምርመራ ካቆመች በኋላ ነው። የንግድ ልውውጡ መቋረጥ በአካባቢው ኢኮኖሚ እና በሺዎች በሚቆጠሩ ሰራተኞች ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ደቅኗል።
oromo: Mootummaan Meeksiikoo naannoo abukaadoo oomishuun beekamu keessatti nageenya mirkaneessuuf waraana 1,500 ol ergeera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame, Ameerikaan rakkoo nageenyaa sababeffachuun qorannoo ergaa abukaadoo dhaabuu ishee hordofeeti. Dhaabbiin daldala kanaa diinagdee naannichaa fi carraa hojii namoota kumaatamaan lakkaa'amanirratti miidhaa qaqqabsiisuu danda'a.

title: Why Israel's opposition no longer wants Palestinian parties in government
english: Israeli opposition leaders are increasingly avoiding coalitions with Palestinian Arab parties, shifting toward a strategy that prioritizes forming a strictly Zionist parliamentary majority. This change follows the events of October 7, which made political partnerships with Arab parties unpopular and risky for centrist candidates. Analysts suggest this trend reflects a hardening of public opinion regarding national identity and security, making the upcoming October elections highly uncertain.
amharic: የእስራኤል ተቃዋሚ ፓርቲ መሪዎች ከአረብ እስራኤላዊ ፓርቲዎች ጋር ጥምረት ከመፍጠር በመቆጠብ፣ በአይሁድ ብሔርተኞች ላይ ብቻ የተመሠረተ መንግሥት ለመመሥረት እየሰሩ ነው። በጥቅምት 7 ቀን ከተፈጠረው ክስተት በኋላ እንዲህ ዓይነቱን ጥምረት መፍጠር ለፖለቲከኞች የደህንነት እና የፖለቲካ ስጋት ሆኗል። በፊታችን ጥቅምት ወር በሚካሄደው ምርጫም የዚህ አዝማሚያ ተጽዕኖ በስፋት እየታየ ሲሆን፣ የአገሪቱ የወደፊት የፖለቲካ ሁኔታም አሳሳቢ ሆኗል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mormituu Israa'el mootummaa isaanii keessatti paartilee Arabaa waliin hojjechuu dhiisuun, deggersa idilee 'Zayoonistoota' qofa irratti xiyyeeffachaa jiru. Kuni ta'e kan dhufe erga mudannoo Onkololeessa 7 booda ta'ee, michummaan paartilee Arabaa waliin uumamu rakkoo siyaasaa fi nageenyaa fiduu akka danda'u hubannoon uumamuun isaa ti. Filannoon Onkololeessa dhufu kanneen akka gara fuulduraatti biyyattii bulchan irratti dhiibbaa guddaa qabaata jedhamee eegama.

title: Morning update
english: Regional tensions have escalated as Houthi attacks in Yemen killed at least 58 people, while separate violence in Syria and the West Bank resulted in further casualties and detentions. In response to the ongoing conflict involving Iran, leaders from Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan are meeting to discuss security and a potential joint defense pact. Meanwhile, U.S. President Donald Trump expressed optimism about an end to the conflict with Iran despite ongoing diplomatic friction.
amharic: በየመን የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ባደረሱት ጥቃት ቢያንስ 58 ሰዎች ሲገደሉ በሶሪያ እና በዌስት ባንክ በተፈጠሩ ግጭቶች ተጨማሪ ጉዳቶችና እስሮች ተከስተዋል። በኢራን ጉዳይ ዙሪያ ለመወያየት የቱርክ፣ የሳውዲ አረቢያ እና የፓኪስታን መሪዎች የጋራ የደህንነት ስምምነት ለማድረግ እየተዘጋጁ ነው። በአንጻሩ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከኢራን ጋር ያለው ግጭት በቅርቡ እንደሚጠናቀቅ እምነታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Yemen keessatti weerara Hutiin gaggeessaniin namoonni 58 ol du'aniru, akkasumas Siiriyaa fi daangaa lixaa keessatti walitti bu'iinsa uumameen midhaan gahuun gabaafameera. Dhimma Iiraan irratti mari'achuuf hogganoonni Turkey, Saudi Arabia fi Pakistan waligaltee nageenyaa gamtaa irratti mari'achuuf karoorfataniiru. Gama biraatiin, Prezidaantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp waraanni Iiraan wajjin jiru akka xumuramutti abdii qaban ibsaniiru.

title: Lebanese army clearing roads in Tyre to facilitate residents' return
english: The Lebanese military has begun clearing debris and opening blocked roads in the southern town of al-Mansouri near Tyre. These efforts follow recent damage caused by Israeli military strikes in the region. The goal of this operation is to allow residents who were forced to flee their homes to return safely.
amharic: የሊባኖስ ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡባዊቷ ጢሮስ ከተማ አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው አል-ማንሱሪ ከተማ የተዘጉ መንገዶችን የማጽዳት ስራ ጀምረዋል። ይህ እንቅስቃሴ የተደረገው በቅርቡ በተፈጸሙ የእስራኤል ጥቃቶች ምክንያት የተጎዱ መንገዶችን ለመጠገን ነው። ዋናው ዓላማውም ከቤታቸው የተፈናቀሉ ነዋሪዎች ወደ ቀያቸው በሰላም እንዲመለሱ ሁኔታዎችን ማመቻቸት ነው።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyyaa Libaanoos daandiiwwan magaalattii Xiiroos, ganda Al-Maansuuri keessatti cufamanii turan banuuf hojii eegaleera. Hojiin kun kan godhame miidhaa lolaa kanaan dura Israa'el geessisteen booda. Kaayyoon isaas namoota bakka buqqa'anii turan gara mana isaaniitti tasgabbiidhaan akka deebi'an gargaaruudha.

title: Record-high heat soars through South Korea
english: South Korea is experiencing an intense and historic heatwave with temperatures climbing as high as 42.5C. This extreme weather has become deadly, leading to at least 14 fatalities since mid-May. Authorities are closely monitoring the situation as the nation struggles to cope with the record-breaking heat.
amharic: ደቡብ ኮሪያ እጅግ ከፍተኛ የሆነ የሙቀት መጠን እየገጠማት ሲሆን የሙቀት መጠኑም እስከ 42.5 ዲግሪ ሴንቲግሬድ ደርሷል። ይህ አስከፊ የአየር ሁኔታ በሰው ልጆች ላይ ጉዳት እያደረሰ ሲሆን ከግንቦት ወር አጋማሽ ጀምሮ ቢያንስ 14 ሰዎች ለህልፈት ተዳርገዋል። ባለስልጣናት በሀገሪቱ እየተመዘገበ ያለውን ይህን አዲስ የሙቀት ክብረ ወሰን ሁኔታ በቅርበት እየተከታተሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Koreaan Kibbaa hoo’i cimaa fi seenaa keessatti mul’atee hin beekne akkaan ishee miidhaa jiruun, ho’inni kun gara 42.5C gahuun gabaafameera. Hoo’i cimaan kun lubbuu namoota 14 caaluu erga ji’a Caamsaa irraa jalqabee kan galaafate yoo ta’u, haalli kun yaaddessaa ta’ee itti fufeera. Mootummaan biyyattii rakkoo ho’a daran dabale kanaan walqabatee of eeggannoo cimaa gochaa jira.

title: Turkiye’s Erdogan visits Saudi Arabia: What to expect
english: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan is visiting Saudi Arabia for a one-day trip to meet with Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman and Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif. The discussions are expected to focus on regional security, particularly the impact of the ongoing conflict between the US, Israel, and Iran. While officials have not confirmed the details, there is speculation that the three nations may move toward establishing a formal joint defense agreement.
amharic: የቱርክ ፕሬዝዳንት ረሲፕ ጣይብ ኤርዶሃን ከአረብ ሀገራት ዘውዳዊ ልዑል መሀመድ ቢን ሳልማን እና ከፓኪስታኑ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሸህባዝ ሻሪፍ ጋር ለመወያየት ሳዑዲ አረቢያን ጎብኝተዋል። የውይይቱ ዋና ትኩረት በክልሉ ያለው የጸጥታ ሁኔታ እና በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ፣ በእስራኤል እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ግጭት የሚያስከትለው ተጽዕኖ ላይ እንደሚሆን ይጠበቃል። ምንም እንኳን በይፋ የተረጋገጠ ባይሆንም፣ ሦስቱ ሀገራት የጋራ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ለመፈራረም እየተዘጋጁ ሊሆን እንደሚችል እየተነገረ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantii Turkiyii Rejeb Tayyib Erdogan, kutaalee biyya Saudi Arabia daawwachuun, mooticha Mohammed bin Salman fi Muummicha Ministira Paakistaan Shehbaz Sharif waliin mari’achaa jiru. Mariin kun haala nageenya naannichaa fi walitti bu’iinsa Ameerikaa, Israa’el fi Iraan gidduu jiru irratti xiyyeeffata jedhamee eegama. Mootummoonni kun waa’ee waliigaltee kanaa ifatti kan hin ibsine ta’us, biyyoonni sadan kun waliigaltee ittisa biyyaa kan waloo ta’e mallatteessuuf akka karoorfatan shakkameera.

title: One killed, four injured in Thailand school shooting, officials say
english: A tragic shooting occurred at a school near Bangkok, Thailand, where a student killed one teacher before taking his own life. Four other individuals were wounded during the incident at the Debsirin Nonthaburi School. Authorities are currently investigating the circumstances behind this violent event, which has raised fresh concerns about school safety in the region.
amharic: ታይላንድ ውስጥ ባንኮክ አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ ትምህርት ቤት በተፈጸመ የሽጉጥ ጥቃት አንድ መምህር ተገድለዋል። ጥቃቱን የፈጸመው ተማሪ ሲሆን ከድርጊቱ በኋላ ራሱን አጥፍቷል። በዚህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት አራት ሰዎች የቆሰሉ ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናት በጉዳዩ ላይ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Naannoo Baangkoogitti mana barumsaa tokko keessatti rasaasa banameen barsiisaan tokko ajjeefamaniiru. Gocha kana kan raawwate barataa ta'uun isaa ibsamee, inniis erga barsiisicha ajjeeseen booda of ajjeeseera. Miidhaa kanaan namoonni afur kanneen biroo madaa'an yoo ta'u, qaamoleen nageenyaa qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: Anti-Muslim US Congressman Andy Ogles loses Republican primary
english: US Congressman Andy Ogles was defeated in the Tennessee Republican primary by Charlie Hatcher, despite receiving a strong endorsement from Donald Trump. Ogles faced significant backlash for his history of inflammatory anti-Muslim remarks, including comments suggesting Muslims should not be part of American society. His opponent, Charlie Hatcher, will now advance to the general election to compete for the House seat against Democratic nominee Chaz Molder.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ኮንግረስ አባል አንዲ ኦግለስ፣ የዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጠንካራ ድጋፍ ቢኖራቸውም በቴነሲ በተካሄደው የሪፐብሊካን የመጀመሪያ ምርጫ በቻርሊ ሃቸር ተሸንፈዋል። ኦግለስ ሙስሊሞች በአሜሪካ ማህበረሰብ ውስጥ ሊኖሩ አይገባም በሚል አወዛጋቢ ንግግራቸው ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ሲገጥማቸው ቆይተዋል። አሸናፊው ቻርሊ ሃቸር በኖቬምበር በሚካሄደው አጠቃላይ ምርጫ ከዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ተወዳዳሪ ቻዝ ሞልደር ጋር ይገጥማሉ።
oromo: Miseensi Kongirasii Yuunaayitid Isteetis Andy Ogles, deeggarsa Donald Trump cimaa qabaatuus, filannoo duraa paartii Rippabilikaanii kan Tennessee irratti Charlie Hatcherin injifatameera. Ogles haasaa jibbiinsa Musliimaarratti xiyyeeffate fi hawaasa Ameerikaa keessatti bakka akka hin qabne ibsuudhaan mormii cimaa mudateera. Mo'ataan filannoo duraa, Charlie Hatcher, filannoo biyyoolessaa Sadaasa dhufu irratti gartuu Diimookraataarraa Chaz Molder waliin morkatu.

title: AI used to create viruses not found in nature for first time
english: Researchers from Stanford, MIT, and Harvard have successfully used artificial intelligence to generate 16 entirely new viruses that do not exist in nature. These synthetic viruses were shown to be highly effective at eliminating E. coli bacteria, offering promising potential for future medical treatments against resistant infections. However, experts warn that this technology also presents significant security risks, highlighting the urgent need for strict oversight and safety regulations.
amharic: የስታንፎርድ፣ የኤምአይቲ እና የሃርቫርድ ተመራማሪዎች በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) በመታገዝ በተፈጥሮ የማይገኙ 16 አዳዲስ ቫይረሶችን መፍጠራቸውን አስታውቀዋል። እነዚህ ሰው ሰራሽ ቫይረሶች ኢ-ኮላይ የተባሉ ባክቴሪያዎችን በማጥፋት ረገድ ውጤታማ መሆናቸው ለወደፊት የሕክምና ግኝቶች ትልቅ ተስፋን ሰጥቷል። ሆኖም የሳይንስ ሊቃውንት ይህ ቴክኖሎጂ ለደህንነት ስጋት ሊዳርግ ስለሚችል ጥብቅ ቁጥጥርና ደንቦች እንደሚያስፈልጉ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Qorattoonni yuuniversitii Stanford, MIT fi Harvard fayyadamuun, vaayirasoota haaraa 16 kan uumamatti hin jirre fayyadamuun mala Artificial Intelligence (AI) uumaniiru. Vaayirasoonni kunneen baakteriyaa E. coli balleessuu keessatti milkaa’ina agarsiisaniiru, kunis dhibee qorichaan hin dabarre wal’aanuu keessatti abdii guddaa qaba. Ta’us, hayyoonni teknolojiin kun nageenyaaf sodaachisaa ta’uu danda’a waan ta’eef, hordoffii cimaa fi seera akka barbaadu akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Death toll from minibus blast in Syria rises to two, 14 others wounded
english: A bomb explosion inside a minibus near Damascus, Syria, has resulted in the deaths of two people and left 14 others injured. Authorities confirmed that the device was hidden within the vehicle while it was in the Jaramana area. Medical and forensic teams are currently managing the aftermath and investigating the scene.
amharic: በሶሪያ ዋና ከተማ ደማስቆ አቅራቢያ በምትገኝ ጃራማና በተባለች አካባቢ ሚኒባስ ውስጥ በተፈጠረ የቦምብ ፍንዳታ ሁለት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ 14 ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ፍንዳታው የተከሰተው በሕዝብ ማመላለሻ ተሽከርካሪው ውስጥ በተቀበረ ፈንጂ መሆኑ ታውቋል። የጤና ጥበቃ ሚኒስቴር ባለሙያዎች እና የፎረንሲክ ቡድኖች በአካባቢው አስፈላጊውን ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Magaalaa guddoo Sooriyaa Damasqoo biratti konkolaataa xiqqaa keessatti boombiin dhohee lubbuun namoota lamaa yoo darbu, namoonni 14 immoo miidhamaniiru. Dhoohichi konkolaataa Jaramanaa keessa ture keessatti boombii qindaa'ee ture irraa kan madde ta'uun mirkanaa'eera. Gareen fayyaa fi ogeeyyiin qorannoo yakkootaa battalumatti gara iddoo sanaa imaluun hojii barbaachisaa ta'e gaggeessaa jiru.

title: Israeli army withdraws after two-day raid in East Jerusalem refugee camp
english: The Israeli military has ended a two-day operation in the Qalandiya refugee camp that resulted in over 50 injuries and the detention of at least 60 Palestinians. During the raid, soldiers repurposed several local buildings into interrogation sites while searching through numerous homes. The camp, located between Jerusalem and Ramallah, is frequently targeted due to its strategic position and high population density.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በቃላንዲያ የስደተኞች ካምፕ ለሁለት ቀናት ያካሄዱትን ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ አጠናቀው ለቀቁ። በዚህ ዘመቻ ወቅት ከ50 በላይ ፍልስጤማውያን ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሲሆን ቢያንስ 60 የሚሆኑት ደግሞ በቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል። ወታደሮቹ የአካባቢውን ቤቶች በመውረርና ለምርመራ ጣቢያነት በመጠቀም በርካታ ሰዎችን ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Warreen Israa'el buufata baqattootaa Qalandiyaa keessatti duula guyyaa lamaa erga geggeessanii booda achi gadhiisanii bahan. Duula kanaan namoonni biyya Palestina 50 ol ta'an miidhamanii, yoo xiqqaate namoonni 60 ol ta'an ammoo qabamaniiru. Loltoonni kunniin manneen jireenyaa fi ijaarsaalee garaa garaa qabatanii bakka namoota itti gaafatanii fi qoran godhatanii turan.

title: US Senator Fetterman struggles to defend support for Israel as progressives win big
english: Senator John Fetterman has reaffirmed his strong backing for Israel, stating he is willing to risk his political standing within the Democratic Party to maintain this position. This comes as progressive candidates advocating for Palestinian rights continue to secure significant victories in primary elections across the United States. A notable example is in Michigan, where Abdul El-Sayed defeated a pro-Israel opponent, highlighting a shift in political momentum.
amharic: ሴናተር ጆን ፌተርማን ለእስራኤል ያላቸውን ጠንካራ ድጋፍ እንደማይቀንሱ ገልጸው፣ ይህ አቋማቸው በዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ውስጥ ያለውን ተቀባይነት ሊያሳጣቸው ቢችልም ከመደገፍ ወደኋላ እንደማይሉ ተናግረዋል። ይህ የተነገረው የፍልስጤማውያንን መብት የሚደግፉ ተራማጅ እጩዎች በአሜሪካ በተካሄዱ ምርጫዎች ጉልህ ድል እያስመዘገቡ ባለበት ወቅት ነው። በተለይም በሚቺጋን ግዛት አብዱል ኤል-ሳየድ በእስራኤል ደጋፊዎች የተደገፈ ተፎካካሪውን በማሸነፋቸው የፖለቲካው አቅጣጫ እየተቀየረ መሆኑን አመላክቷል።
oromo: Senator John Fetterman deggarsa Israa'eliif qabu akka hin laaffisne ibsuun, kunis paartii isaa keessatti beekamtii isaa yoo dhabsiises yaada isaa irraa akka hin deebine dubbateera. Kun kan ta'e yeroo mirga Palastiyinii kan deggeran kaadhimamtoonni garaagarummaa qaban biyyattii keessatti injifannoo argachaa jiranitti. Keessattuu godina Michigan keessatti, Abdul El-Sayed morkataa Israa'eliin deggeramu injifachuun isaa jijjiirama siyaasaa mul'isa.

title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan to sign joint defence deal on Friday
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan are set to finalize a collaborative defense agreement this Friday in Jeddah. This partnership is designed to improve regional security cooperation between the three nations. Officials noted that while the deal has been in the works for a while, growing tensions in the region have accelerated the need for the pact.
amharic: ሳዑዲ አረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን በመጪው አርብ በጅዳ የጋራ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ለመፈራረም ተዘጋጅተዋል። ይህ ስምምነት በሦስቱ አገራት መካከል ያለውን የጸጥታ ትብብር ለማጠናከር ያለመ ነው። ባለሥልጣናቱ እንደገለጹት ስምምነቱ ለረጅም ጊዜ ሲነጋገርበት የቆየ ቢሆንም፣ በአካባቢው እየጨመረ የመጣው አለመረጋጋት ሂደቱን እንዲፋጠን አድርጎታል።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan, Tarkii fi Paakistaan Jimaata dhufu kana magaalaa Jeddahitti waliigaltee ittisa biyyaa gamtaan mallatteessuuf qophaa'aniiru. Waliigalteen kun biyyoota sadan gidduutti hariiroo nageenyaa cimsuuf kan gargaaru dha. Akka qondaalonni jedhanitti, waliigalteen kun yeroo dheeraaf kan karoorfamaa ture ta'us, rakkoolee naannichatti uumamaa jiran irraa kan ka'e ariifachiifameera.

title: Israel's Bennet calls Qatar a 'cancer' and an 'enemy'
english: Former Israeli Prime Minister Naftali Bennett has publicly labeled Qatar as an enemy and a major threat to Israel. He accused the nation of funding the ICC's efforts to issue arrest warrants for Israeli officials. Bennett further claimed that Qatar's actions directly contribute to the deaths of Israeli soldiers and citizens.
amharic: የቀድሞው የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ናፍታሊ ቤኔት ኳታርን እንደ ጠላት እና ለእስራኤል ትልቅ አደጋ እንደሆነች በይፋ ገልጸዋል። አገሪቱ ዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት በእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት ላይ የእስር ማዘዣ እንዲያወጣ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እያደረገች ነው ሲሉ ከሰዋል። ቤኔት አክለውም የኳታር ድርጊቶች የእስራኤል ወታደሮች እና ዜጎች እንዲገደሉ ምክንያት እየሆኑ ነው ብለዋል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa duraanii Israa'el Naftaali Beneet, biyyi Qaatar diina Israa'el ta'uu fi balaa guddaa akka taate ibsaniiru. Qaatar duula Manni Murtii Yakka Addunyaa (ICC) qondaaltota Israa'el irratti ajaja hidhaa baasuuf taasisuuf maallaqa akka kennitu himataniiru. Beneet itti dabaluunis, gochi Qaatar kallattiin du'a loltootaa fi lammiilee Israa'elirratti gahee akka qabu dubbataniiru.

title: Australian aviation crew carries out daring midwinter Antarctica rescue
english: An Australian aviation team successfully completed a dangerous medical rescue mission in Antarctica during the midwinter season. Despite extreme darkness and temperatures hitting -43C, the crew managed to land an Airbus A319 at the US-run McMurdo Station to retrieve an ill expedition member. The patient was safely flown to New Zealand, where they are now recovering well after this complex and highly specialized operation.
amharic: የአውስትራሊያ አቪዬሽን ቡድን በክረምት ወራት በአንታርክቲካ ውስጥ አስቸጋሪ የሆነ የህክምና የማዳን ስራ በተሳካ ሁኔታ አጠናቋል። እጅግ በጣም ጨለማ እና -43 ዲግሪ ሴልሺየስ በሆነ ቅዝቃዜ ውስጥ፣ የአውሮፕላን አብራሪዎች የኤርባስ ኤ319 አውሮፕላንን በአሜሪካ የጥናት ጣቢያ በማሳረፍ ታማሚውን የጉዞ ቡድን አባል ማዳን ችለዋል። ታማሚው በአስተማማኝ ሁኔታ ወደ ኒውዚላንድ ተወስዶ አሁን በጥሩ ሁኔታ ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Garee ogeessota xiyyaaraa Awustiraaliyaa tokko, yeroo gannaa qorrisaa keessa Antaarkitikaatti hojii fayyaa gargaaruu cimaa tokko milkeessanii jiru. Haala dukkana guddaa fi qorraa -43 digrii seelsiyesii ta'e keessatti, ogeessonni kun xiyyaara Airbus A319 buusuun miseensa garee qorannoo tokko kan dhukkubsate oolchanii jiru. Namichi dhukkubsatee ture kun nagaan gara Niwuu Ziilaandiitti geeffamee, amma fayyaa ta'ee wal'ansa argachaa jira.

title: Trump again tries to limit US birthright citizenship with new executive orders
english: President Trump has issued new executive orders aimed at restricting birthright citizenship for children born to non-citizens in the United States. These measures specifically target individuals connected to foreign governments, terrorist organizations, or those involved in fraudulent activities, while also seeking to ban so-called birth tourism. This initiative marks another effort by the administration to challenge a long-standing policy despite previous legal setbacks.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በአሜሪካ የሚወለዱ ህጻናት በዜግነት የማግኘት መብት ላይ ገደብ የሚጥሉ አዳዲስ የስራ አስፈፃሚ ትዕዛዞችን አስተላልፈዋል። እነዚህ እርምጃዎች የውጭ መንግስታት ሰራተኞችን፣ የሽብር ቡድን አባላትን እና በህገወጥ መንገድ ዜግነት ለማግኘት የሚሞክሩ ግለሰቦችን ያነጣጠሩ ሲሆኑ፣ ለዜግነት ሲባል የሚደረግ የወሊድ ጉብኝትንም ይከለክላሉ። ይህ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ከዚህ ቀደም በፍርድ ቤት ውድቅ ከተደረገው ሙከራ በኋላ፣ ይህንን የቆየ ፖሊሲ ለመለወጥ የሚያደርገው አዲስ ጥረት ነው።
oromo: Preezdaanti Tiraamp ijoollee biyya alaatiif dhalatan biyyatti keessatti mirga lammiummaa argachuu irratti daangaa kaa'uuf ajaja haarawa baasaniiru. Ajajni kun namoota mootummoota alaa, garee shororkeessaa fi malaan fayyadamanii lammiummaa barbaadan irratti xiyyeeffata; akkasumas daa'imman lammiummaa argachuuf qofa biyyatti dhufanii deeman (birth tourism) akka hin jiraanne dhowwa. Tarkaanfiin kun yaalii isaanii kan duraanii kan mana murtii irraa mormiin irratti ka'e booda, dhimma mirga lammiummaa kana jijjiiruuf deebii lammaffaa kan godhameedha.

title: More than one million affected by floods in India’s Assam state
english: Severe monsoon rains have caused devastating flooding in India's Assam state, impacting over a million residents since July. Thousands of people have been forced to flee their homes due to the rising waters. Tragically, the disaster has resulted in the loss of at least 87 lives so far.
amharic: በህንድ የአሳም ግዛት ከሀምሌ ወር ጀምሮ በጣለ የከባድ የዝናብ ወቅት የተከሰተ ጎርፍ ከአንድ ሚሊዮን በላይ ሰዎችን ለችግር ዳርጓል። በዚህ የተፈጥሮ አደጋ ሳቢያ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ነዋሪዎች ከቀያቸው የተፈናቀሉ ሲሆን፣ እስካሁን በደረሰው መረጃ መሰረት ቢያንስ 87 ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን አጥተዋል።
oromo: Godina Aasaam kan Indiyaa keessatti, roobni cimaan ji'a Adoolessaa irraa eegalee roobaa jiru lolaa hamaa uumee jiraattoota miiliyoona tokkoo ol miidhee jira. Namoonni kumaan lakkaawwaman lolaa kanaan qe'ee isaanii irraa kan buqqa'an yoo ta'u, hanga ammaatti lubbuun namoota 87 ol ta'uu gabaafameera.

title: Exclusive report with the 308 people rescued by Nigerian forces
english: Nigerian security forces successfully liberated 308 individuals who had been kidnapped during recent attacks in the Kwara and Niger states. These abductions highlight the growing security challenge posed by armed criminal groups frequently targeting civilians for ransom. The survivors are now receiving support and recovering from their traumatic experiences.
amharic: የናይጄሪያ የፀጥታ ሃይሎች በናይጄር እና በክዋራ ግዛቶች በቅርቡ በተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች ታግተው የነበሩ 308 ሰዎችን በሰላም ነፃ አውጥተዋል። ይህ አፈና ታጣቂ ቡድኖች ለቤዛ ሲሉ ሲፈጽሙት የነበረው ችግር ምን ያህል አሳሳቢ መሆኑን ያሳያል። የተለቀቁት ሰዎች በአሁኑ ወቅት ከደረሰባቸው የስነ-ልቦና እና የአካል ጉዳት ለማገገም ድጋፍ እየተደረገላቸው ነው።
oromo: Humnoonni nageenyaa Naayijeeriyaa namoota 308 naannolee Naayijeer fi Kwaara keessatti weerara adda addaatiin butamanii turan nagayaan bilisa baasaniiru. Buttiin kun gareewwan hidhattootaa maallaqa butuu (fudhatuuf) jecha raawwatanii fi dhimma nageenyaa biyyattii mudate kan agarsiisuudha. Namoonni bilisa baafaman kunis miidhaa isaanirra gahe booda amma deebisanii dhaabbachuuf gargaarsa argachaa jiru.

title: Israeli raid in West Bank’s Qalandiya injures 51 Palestinians
english: Israeli forces conducted a major raid in the Qalandiya refugee camp, resulting in injuries to at least 51 Palestinians and the destruction of local businesses. During the operation, soldiers imposed a curfew, detained numerous residents, and obstructed emergency medical teams from reaching the wounded. This event is part of a broader trend of escalating military and settler violence throughout the occupied West Bank.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በቃላንዲያ የስደተኞች መጠለያ ጣቢያ ባደረጉት መጠነ ሰፊ ዘመቻ ቢያንስ 51 ፍልስጤማውያን መቁሰላቸውንና በርካታ የንግድ ድርጅቶች መፍረሳቸውን ተዘግቧል። ወታደሮቹ በአካባቢው የሰዓት እላፊ ገደብ በመጣል በርካታ ነዋሪዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋሉ ሲሆን የህክምና ቡድኖች ተጎጂዎችን እንዳያገኙ እንቅፋት ፈጥረዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት እየጨመረ የመጣው ወታደራዊ እና የአምባገነን ሰፈራ ጥቃቶች አካል ነው።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el qubata baqattoota Qalandiyaa irratti duula gaggeesseen palastineelonni 51 ol miidhamee jiru akkasumas gabaawwan hedduun diigamaniiru. Duula kana keessatti waraanni kun seera daangaa yeroo labsuun namoota hedduu hidhe, akkasumas gargaarsa hatattamaa fayyaa akka hin geenye dhorkeera. Miidhaan kun kan agarsiisu walitti bu'iinsa waraanaa fi weerartoota biyyaa wajjin walqabatee naannoo Waanzi Baankiitti babal'achaa jiru dha.

title: New Mexico court orders Meta to pay $567m over harm to youths
english: A New Mexico judge has ordered Meta to pay $567 million after concluding that the company’s social media platforms negatively impacted the mental health of young users. In addition to the financial penalty, which will fund youth mental health services and prevention programs, Meta is required to modify its platforms with better safety tools and informational features. The company plans to appeal the decision, maintaining that it is committed to protecting teenagers online.
amharic: የኒው ሜክሲኮ ፍርድ ቤት ሜታ የተባለው ኩባንያ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ መድረኮቹ ለወጣቶች የአእምሮ ጤና መታወክ ምክንያት በመሆኑ 567 ሚሊዮን ዶላር እንዲከፍል ወስኗል። ከገንዘብ ቅጣቱ በተጨማሪ ኩባንያው ለወጣቶች ደህንነት ሲባል የፌስቡክ እና ኢንስታግራም አጠቃቀምን በማሻሻል አዳዲስ የመከላከያ ዘዴዎችን ተግባራዊ እንዲያደርግ ታዟል። ሜታ ውሳኔውን በመቃወም ይግባኝ እንደሚጠይቅ ገልጾ፣ ታዳጊዎችን ከጎጂ ይዘቶች ለመጠበቅ እየሰራ መሆኑን ተናግሯል።
oromo: Mana murtii Niiw Meeksiikoo, dhaabbanni Meeta sagantaawwan isaa miidiyaa hawaasummaan dargaggoota irratti miidhaa sammuu geessiseera jechuun qarshii miliyoona 567 akka kaffalu murteesseera. Adabbii maallaqaa kana cinaatti, dhaabbatichi dhimmoota fayyaa sammuu dargaggootaa fi eegumsa isaaniirratti fooyya'insa akka godhu dirqamsiifameera. Meetaan murtee kana mormuun ol-iyyannoo kan galchu ta'uu fi dargaggoota interneetii irraa eeguuf hojjechaa jiraachuu isaa ibseera.

title: Brazil formally accuses 16 people over 2024 Voepass deadly plane crash
english: Brazilian police have officially accused 16 individuals, including the owner of Voepass airline, following a 2024 plane crash that resulted in the deaths of 62 people. Authorities found that the flight was improperly allowed to depart despite known issues with the aircraft’s de-icing system and severe weather conditions. Prosecutors will now determine if these individuals, who face potential prison time for negligence, will be formally charged for their roles in the disaster.
amharic: የብራዚል ፌዴራል ፖሊስ እ.ኤ.አ በ2024 የ62 ሰዎችን ህይወት የቀጠፈውን የቮፓስ አየር መንገድ አደጋ ተከትሎ የኩባንያው ባለቤትን ጨምሮ በ16 ግለሰቦች ላይ ክስ መሰረተ። ምርመራው እንደሚያሳየው አውሮፕላኑ የበረዶ መከላከያ ስርዓቱ ችግር እንዳለበት እየታወቀ እና መጥፎ የአየር ሁኔታ እያለ በስህተት ለመብረር ፈቃድ ተሰጥቶት ነበር። አቃቤ ህግ የተጠረጠሩት ግለሰቦች ለቸልተኝነት ወንጀል ፍርድ ቤት ቀርበው ክስ እንደሚመሰረትባቸው በቅርቡ ይወስናል።
oromo: Poolisiin Biraazil balaa xiyyaaraa bara 2024 lubbuu namoota 62 galaafateen walqabatee, abbaa qabeenyaa kampaanii xiyyaaraa Voepass dabalatee namoota 16 irratti himata baneera. Qorannoon akka agarsiisutti, xiyyaarichi sirni cabbii ittisuu isaa miidhamee utuu jiruu fi haalli qilleensaa hamaa ta'uu isaa utuu beekamuufiif hayyamamee akka ka'u ta'eera. Himatamtoonni kun balaa kanaaf gaafatamummaa kan qaban ta'uun isaanii mirkanaa'eera, akkasumas abbaan alangaa himatni kun gara sadarkaa mana murtiitti akka darbu ni murteessa.

title: Meta fined $567m in largest child safety ruling against social media giant
english: A New Mexico judge has ordered Meta to pay a $567 million penalty for failing to protect children from harmful content and predators on its platforms. The court labeled the company a public nuisance, comparing its impact on youth safety to environmental pollution. This ruling brings the total financial judgment against Meta in this case to $942 million, which will be used to fund efforts to prevent future online harms to minors.
amharic: የኒው ሜክሲኮ ዳኛ ሜታ በፕላትፎርሞቹ ላይ ህጻናትን ከጎጂ ይዘቶች እና ከወንጀለኞች መጠበቅ ባለመቻሉ 567 ሚሊዮን ዶላር እንዲቀጣ ወስነዋል። ፍርድ ቤቱ የኩባንያውን ድርጊት እንደ አካባቢ ብክለት በመቁጠር ለህዝብ ደህንነት ስጋት እንደሆነ ገልጿል። ይህን ጨምሮ ሜታ በህጻናት ደህንነት ጉዳይ በአጠቃላይ 942 ሚሊዮን ዶላር እንዲከፍል የተወሰነበት ሲሆን፣ ገንዘቡም ወደፊት በህጻናት ላይ የሚደርሰውን የመስመር ላይ ጉዳት ለመከላከል ይውላል።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa biyya New Mexico, kampanii Meta ijoollee miidhaa fi badiirraa eeguu dadhabuusaatiin gara $567 miliyoonaan akka adabamu murteesse. Manni murtichaa gocha kampanichaa akka faalama qilleensaa gadiitti ilaalun, nageenya ijoolleerratti balaa akka qabu ibseera. Adabbii kanaan walqabatee, Meta waliigalatti gara $942 miliyoonaa akka kafalu kan murtaa'e yoo ta'u, maallaqni kunis gara fuulduraatti miidhaa ijoolleerratti raawwatamu ittisuuf kan oolu ta'a.

title: Uefa says boycott may still go ahead as FA withdraws Infantino support
english: European football associations, led by Uefa, are considering a boycott of major tournaments because they lack confidence in Fifa president Gianni Infantino. The English FA recently withdrew its support for the president following a controversial plan to sell stakes in the World Cup to private investors. Although Fifa apologized for the process, Uefa maintains that its demands for transparency and assurances against similar future schemes have not been met.
amharic: የአውሮፓ እግር ኳስ ማህበራት በፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ ላይ ያላቸው እምነት በመቀነሱ በዋንጫ ውድድሮች ላይ የቦይኮት እርምጃ ለመውሰድ እያሰቡ ነው። የእንግሊዝ እግር ኳስ ማህበር የዓለም ዋንጫን ድርሻ ለግል ባለሀብቶች ለመሸጥ የታቀደውን አወዛጋቢ እቅድ ተከትሎ ለኢንፋንቲኖ የነበረውን ድጋፍ አቋርጧል። ፊፋ በሂደቱ ላይ ለተፈጠረው ስህተት ይቅርታ ቢጠይቅም፣ ዩኤፋ እንደዚህ አይነት ግልጽ ያልሆኑ አሰራሮች ዳግም እንደማይከሰቱ ማረጋገጫ ስላልተሰጠው አቋሙን አላቀረም።
oromo: Gamtaan kubbaa miilaa Awurooppaa, miseensonni isaa pirezidaantii FIFA Jiyaanii Infaantinootti amanamummaa waan dhabaniif, dorgommiiwwan gurguddoo irratti hirmaachuu dhiisuuf yaadaa jiru. Federeeshiniin kubbaa miilaa Ingiliz akkaataa itti qooda Waldaa Ardii (World Cup) daldaltoota dhuunfaaf gurguruuf karoorfame mormuun, deeggarsa pirezidaantichaaf qabu dhaabeera. FIFA rakkoo uumameef dhiifama gaafatus, gamtaan Awurooppaa (Uefa) akkaataa gaggeessaa pirezidaantichaa irratti amanamummaa waan dhabeef, gariin kun gara fuulduraatti akka hin irra deddeebine waadaa amansiisaa hin arganne.

title: South Korea space agency shares Moon images after SpaceX rocket debris crash
english: South Korea's space agency has released images of the Moon's surface following an accidental collision with a discarded SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket component. The large piece of space debris struck the Moon at high speed after drifting in orbit since early 2024. While the crash posed no risk to Earth, experts are highlighting growing concerns about the accumulation of junk in space and the potential challenges this creates for future missions.
amharic: የደቡብ ኮሪያ የጠፈር ምርምር ኤጀንሲ በአጋጣሚ በጨረቃ ላይ ከወደቀው የSpaceX ፋልኮን 9 ሮኬት ክፍል በኋላ የጨረቃን ገጽታ የሚያሳዩ ምስሎችን ይፋ አድርጓል። ይህ ትልቅ የጠፈር ፍርስራሽ ከ2024 መጀመሪያ ጀምሮ በጠፈር ሲንሳፈፍ ቆይቶ በከፍተኛ ፍጥነት ነው ጨረቃን የመታው። ምንም እንኳን ግጭቱ በምድር ላይ ምንም አይነት ስጋት ባይፈጥርም፣ የጠፈር ባለሙያዎች በጠፈር ውስጥ የሚከማቸው ፍርስራሽ እየጨመረ መምጣቱ ለወደፊት የጠፈር ጉዞዎች ስጋት ሊሆን እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Ejensii hawaa biyya Koriyaa Kibbaa, kutaan rokketii SpaceX Falcon 9 jedhamu tokko osoo hin yaadaminiifi qajeelfama malee gara ji'aatti erga bu'ee booda, suuraalee gubbaa ji'ichaa ifa godheera. Kutaaleen rokketii kanaa bara 2024 jalqabaa kaasee hawaa keessa utuu naanna'uu, saffisa guddaadhaan ji'a rukuteera. Gahuumsi kun lafarra namarratti miidhaa kan hin qaqqabsiisne ta'us, ogeeyyonni hawaa haala kanaan kosiiwwan hawaa keessatti walitti qabaman gara fuulduraatti hojiiwwan qorannoo hawaa irratti gufuu ta'uu akka danda'an akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Thousands of migrants still in Ceuta after border crisis, local leader says
english: Following a massive influx of migrants into the Spanish territory of Ceuta, thousands of individuals, including many children, still remain in the enclave. Local leader Juan Jesús Vivas described the situation as a humanitarian emergency and criticized the national government for its delayed response to the crisis. While many people have returned to Morocco, officials are struggling to manage the large number of unaccompanied minors who cannot be easily sent back.
amharic: ወደ ስፔን ግዛት ሴኡታ በገቡ በርካታ ስደተኞች ምክንያት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች፣ ሕፃናትን ጨምሮ አሁንም አካባቢው ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። የክልሉ መሪ ሁዋን ጄሱስ ቪቫስ ሁኔታውን የሰብአዊ ቀውስ ሲሉ የገለጹት ሲሆን፣ ለችግሩ ፈጣን ምላሽ ባለመስጠቱ የሀገሪቱን መንግስት ተችተዋል። ብዙ ስደተኞች ወደ ሞሮኮ ቢመለሱም፣ ባለስልጣናት ያለ አጃቢ ወደ ግዛቷ የገቡትን በርካታ ህጻናት ጉዳይ ለመፍታት በመቸገር ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Godina Spain kan ta'e Ceuta keessatti baqattoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman, ijoollee hedduu dabalatee, ammallee achi jiraachuun ibsameera. Hogganaan naannichaa Juan Jesús Vivas haalicha balaa namoomaa jechuun waamamanii, mootummaan biyyattii deebii ariifachiisaa hin kennine jechuun ceepha'aniiru. Baqattoonni hedduun gara Morookootti deebi'anis, mootummaan ijoollee duubatti deebisuun rakkisaa waan ta'eef, ijoollee eegduu hin qabne kunuunsuu irratti rakkoo guddaa keessa galanii jiru.

title: After the floods, hunger: Mozambique’s second disaster
english: Following devastating floods in early 2026, many families in Mozambique are now facing a severe hunger crisis. The floods destroyed critical infrastructure, livestock, and vast areas of farmland, leaving farmers unable to support themselves. With local harvests gone and transportation routes damaged, food prices have soared, making it difficult for residents to access affordable meals.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. በ2026 መጀመሪያ ላይ በሞዛምቢክ በደረሰው ከፍተኛ የጎርፍ አደጋ ምክንያት ብዙ ቤተሰቦች አሁን ለከባድ የምግብ እጥረት ተጋልጠዋል። ጎርፉ አስፈላጊ የሆኑ መሠረተ ልማቶችን፣ የቤት እንስሳትን እና ሰፊ የእርሻ መሬቶችን በማውደሙ አርሶ አደሮች ራሳቸውን መመገብ አቅቷቸዋል። በአካባቢው የሚገኝ ምርት በመውደሙ እና የመጓጓዣ መንገዶች በመበላሸታቸው የምግብ ዋጋ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ በመጨመሩ ነዋሪዎች ምግባቸውን ለማግኘት ተቸግረዋል።
oromo: Muddee bara 2025 fi jalqaba bara 2026 biyya Mozaambiikitti lolaa cimaa mudateen booda, maatiiwwan hedduun rakkoo beelaa cimaa keessa jiru. Lolaan kun oomisha qonnaa, horii fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa hedduu waan barbadeesseef, qotee bulaan of gargaaruu dadhabeera. Oomishni badee fi daandileen cufamuun gatiin midhaanii dachaan dabaluun, namoonni nyaata argachuun akka itti ulfaate taasiseera.

title: Trump says war can’t ‘go much longer’, Hormuz deal close
english: US President Donald Trump has expressed confidence that the ongoing conflict with Iran will reach a resolution shortly. Meanwhile, Iran and Oman are nearing a final agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. This development signals a potential de-escalation of tensions in a vital region for global energy supplies.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከኢራን ጋር ያለው ግጭት በቅርቡ እንደሚፈታ ያላቸውን እምነት ገልጸዋል። በሌላ በኩል ኢራን እና ኦማን የሆርሙዝ ስትሬትን እንደገና ለመክፈት ከስምምነት መድረሳቸው ተነግሯል። ይህ ለዓለም የኃይል አቅርቦት ወሳኝ በሆነው አካባቢ ያለውን ውጥረት ለመቀነስ አስተዋፅዖ ይኖረዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Amerikaa Donald Traamp walitti bu’iinsi Iraan waliin jiru gara fuulduraatti yeroodhuma gabaabaa keessatti furata akka argatu abdii qaban ibsaniiru. Gama biraatiin, Iraan fi Omaanon daandii galaana Hormuz deebisanii banuuf waliigaltee irra gahuuf gahuu isaanii gabaasameera. Tarkaanfiin kun naannawa dhiyeessii anniisaa addunyaaf barbaachisaa ta’e kana keessatti gargar ba’iinsa ykn waldhabdee hir’isuuf gargaara.

title: Travel restrictions – from Israel and Europe – trap students in Gaza
english: Students in Gaza are struggling to pursue higher education abroad due to severe travel restrictions and complex bureaucratic obstacles. Despite receiving scholarship offers from European universities, many remain trapped in the territory and unable to reach their schools. These movement barriers continue to shatter the academic dreams of talented individuals seeking to escape the ongoing conflict.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ ተማሪዎች በትራንስፖርት እገዳዎች እና በቢሮክራሲያዊ ችግሮች ምክንያት በውጭ አገር የትምህርት እድላቸውን ለመከታተል እየተቸገሩ ነው። ከአውሮፓ ዩኒቨርሲቲዎች የትምህርት ዕድል ቢሰጣቸውም፣ ብዙዎቹ በጦርነቱ እና በእገዳው ምክንያት ከጋዛ መውጣት አልቻሉም። እነዚህ የእንቅስቃሴ ገደቦች የተማሩ ወጣቶችን የወደፊት ተስፋ እና የትምህርት ህልም እያጨናገፉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Barattoonni Gaazaatti argaman uggura imalaafi rakkoo biirokrasii hamaa keessa jiruun barnoota biyya alaa hordofuuf dhibaa'aa jiru. Yuunivarsitiiwwan Awurooppaa irraa carraa barnootaa argatanis, hedduun isaanii walitti bu'iinsaafi uggura jiruun kan ka'e gara biyyoota sanaa qaqqabachuu hin dandeenye. Gufuun kunis abjuu barattootaa kanneen gara fuulduraatti abdii qaban irratti dhiibbaa hamaa geessisaa jira.

title: ‘No red line’: South Lebanon residents outraged as Israel resumes strikes
english: Residents of southern Lebanon are feeling frustrated and abandoned as Israel recently resumed military strikes and issued new evacuation orders. Many locals believe the current ceasefire agreement has failed, noting that Israeli forces are destroying homes and farmlands while official negotiations in Rome show little progress. Families remain displaced and fearful, expressing a deep lack of trust in their government to protect them or secure their safe return home.
amharic: እስራኤል በደቡብ ሊባኖስ ላይ ጥቃቶችን እና አዳዲስ የመልቀቂያ ትዕዛዞችን በማስተላለፏ የክልሉ ነዋሪዎች ከፍተኛ ቁጣ እና ብስጭት እየተሰማቸው ነው። ነዋሪዎቹ አሁን ያለው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ምንም አይነት ጥበቃ እየሰጣቸው አይደለም በማለት መንግስታቸው ችላ ማለቱን ይወቅሳሉ። በሮም እየተካሄደ ያለው የሰላም ድርድር እስካሁን ምንም አይነት ተጨባጭ ውጤት ባለማምጣቱ፣ የተፈናቀሉ ቤተሰቦች ወደ ቀያቸው ለመመለስ ያላቸው ተስፋ እየሟጠጠ ነው።
oromo: Israa'el gammoojjii kibba Libaanoos irratti haleellaa haaromsuu fi ajaja baqannaa haaraa dabarsuu isheen, jiraattonni naannichaa aarii fi abdii kutannaa akka itti dhaga'amu godheera. Jiraattonni walii galteen dhaabbii waraanaa ammaa kun bu'aa akka hin qabne fi mootummaan isaanii akka isaan irraanfate amanu. Mariin nagaa Roomaatti gaggeeffamaa jiru bu'aa qabatamaa waan hin fidneef, maatiin buqqa'an mana isaaniitti deebi'uuf abdii kutataniiru.

title: Trump signs executive orders banning so-called ‘birth tourism’
english: Former President Donald Trump issued executive orders aimed at restricting the practice of birth tourism in the United States. These new measures seek to limit who qualifies for automatic citizenship granted to children born on American soil. This action follows a previous attempt by his administration to adjust birthright citizenship policies, which had been blocked by the Supreme Court.
amharic: የቀድሞው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ የሚስተዋለውን 'የልደት ቱሪዝም' ለመገደብ የሚያስችሉ ሁለት አስፈጻሚ ትዕዛዞችን አውጥተዋል። እነዚህ እርምጃዎች በአሜሪካ ምድር ለሚወለዱ ሕፃናት በራስ-ሰር የሚሰጠውን የዜግነት መብት ለማጥበብ ያለሙ ናቸው። ይህ እንቅስቃሴ ከዚህ ቀደም በአስተዳደራቸው ተሞክሮ በጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት የታገደውን የዜግነት ፖሊሲ ለማሻሻል የተደረገ ሌላ ሙከራ ነው።
oromo: Pirezedantiin duraanii Doonaald Tiraamp biyya Ameerikaa keessatti dhalootaaf jedhanii imaluu (birth tourism) akka daangeessan ajaja mootummaa lachuu mallatteessaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun daa'imman biyyattii keessatti dhalatan hundaaf akkaataa itti lammummaan Ameerikaa kennamuufirratti murtoo cimaa kan godhuudha. Gochi kun kanaan dura yaalii mootummaan isaanii godhee Mana Murtii Waliigalaatiin dhaabamee ture sana deebi'anii yaaluu dha.

title: At least 17 soldiers, officer killed in Houthi attacks in Yemen
english: At least 18 members of the Yemeni military, including an officer, were killed during recent assaults carried out by Houthi forces in the Marib and Hadramout regions. In response, the Yemeni military expressed its commitment to continue defending the country and restoring state authority despite the violence. The armed forces stated that these attacks have only strengthened their resolve to secure national territory.
amharic: በየመን ማሪብ እና ሀድራሙት ክልሎች በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ቢያንስ 18 የየመን ወታደራዊ አባላትና አንድ መኮንን ተገድለዋል። የየመን ወታደራዊ አመራር ጥቃቱ ቢደርስም ሀገርን የመከላከል እና የመንግስት ስልጣንን የማስከበር ስራቸውን አጠናክረው እንደሚቀጥሉ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ፈሪሳዊ ጥቃት የሀገሪቱን ሰራዊት ቁርጠኝነት የበለጠ እንደሚያጠነክረውም መግለጫው ጠቁሟል።
oromo: Godina Maariib fi Hadramuutitti haleellaa garee Huutii gaggeesseen waraana Yemen irraa namoonni 18 yoo du’an, isaan keessaa ajajaan tokko argamu. Waraanni Yemenis haleellaa kana booda biyyaa fi mootummaa isaanii kabachiisuuf dirqama isaanii akka cimsatanii itti fufan ibseera. Raayyaan ittisa biyyattii haleellaan kun gootummaa isaanii malee dadhabbii akka hin taane ibsaniiru.

title: Israel’s Mossad chief fires two senior officials over failure to topple Iran’s leadership
english: The head of Israel's Mossad has dismissed two high-ranking officials following the failure of their clandestine plot to destabilize the Iranian government. The plan involved inciting ethnic minorities and fueling public unrest to overthrow the country's leadership, but the strategy ultimately proved unsuccessful. These officials, who led the agency's intelligence and Iran-specific divisions, were removed from their positions as a direct consequence of this strategic blunder.
amharic: የእስራኤል የውጭ መረጃ አገልግሎት ሞሳድ ሃላፊ፣ የኢራንን መንግስት ለመጣል ተነድፎ የነበረው እቅድ በመክሸፉ ሁለት ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣናትን ከስራ አሰናብተዋል። ባለስልጣናቱ የኢራንን አናሳ ብሄረሰቦች በማነሳሳት እና ህዝባዊ አመፅ በመቀስቀስ የሀገሪቱን አመራር ለማስወገድ ሞክረው ነበር፣ ነገር ግን ይህ ሙከራ ውጤታማ ሳይሆን ቀርቷል። በድርጅቱ ውስጥ የመረጃ ክፍልን እና የኢራን ጉዳዮችን ይመሩ የነበሩት እነዚህ ግለሰቦች፣ በእቅዱ ውድቀት ምክንያት ከኃላፊነታቸው ተነስተዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan tajaajila iccitii Israa'el kan ta'e Mossad, mootummaa Iraan fonqolchuuf karoorfamee ture keessatti qooda fudhachuun isaanii waan hin milkoofneef, qondaaltota ol'aanoo lama hojiirraa ari'eera. Qondaaltotni kunneen saboota xixiqqoo Iraan keessa jiran kakaasuufi hiriira guddaa gaggeessuun mootummaa fonqolchuuf karoorfatanii turan, ta'us karoora isaanii kana milkeessuu hin dandeenye. Namoonni kunneen kanaan dura qajeelcha iccitii fi damee Iraan hoogganaa turan, rakkoo kana hordofuun hojiirraa bilisa ta'aniiru.

title: Saudi, Turkish, Pakistan leaders to hold summit in Jeddah
english: Leaders from Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan are scheduled to meet this Friday in Jeddah for a high-level summit. While the specific topics for discussion have not been officially disclosed, the meeting occurs during a period of significant regional tension regarding the Strait of Hormuz. Observers are closely watching the event given the current standoff between the United States and Iran.

Mataduree walgahichaa ilaalchisee ibsi ifa ta’e tokko hin kennamne, ta’us walgahiin kun yeroo humnoota Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti dhimma qarqara galaana Hormuz irratti wal-dhibdeen uumamee jiru kanatti ta’uun isaa xiyyeeffannoo argateera.

title: Israeli artillery attack on town in southern Lebanon
english: The Israeli military conducted artillery strikes against the Lebanese town of Hadatha. These attacks occurred simultaneously with ongoing diplomatic discussions in Rome aimed at establishing a formal framework between Israel and Lebanon. Despite the push for negotiations, there has been a noticeable increase in military activity by Israel within Lebanese territory.

Mariin kun sadarkaa irra jirutti, Israa'el gammoojjii Liibaanoos keessatti tarkaanfii waraanaa ishee daran cimaa gochaa jirti.

title: Saudi official says it expects imminent attacks from Houthis and aligned groups
english: A high-ranking Saudi official has warned of potential incoming attacks on the country's energy and infrastructure sites by Iraqi militias and Houthi rebels. Intelligence suggests these groups are receiving guidance from Iran to coordinate drone and missile strikes from multiple directions. This planned aggression appears intended to undermine ongoing regional peace talks and diplomatic progress.
amharic: ከፍተኛ የሳውዲ ባለስልጣን ኢራቅ ውስጥ የሚንቀሳቀሱ ታጣቂዎች ከሁቲ አማፂያን ጋር በመተባበር በሳውዲ ኢነርጂ እና መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ ጥቃት ለመሰንዘር እቅድ እንዳላቸው አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ጥቃት በኢራን አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ድጋፍ የሚደረግበት ሲሆን፣ ዓላማውም በክልሉ እየተካሄደ ያለውን የዲፕሎማሲ እና የሰላም ሂደት ለማስተጓጎል እንደሆነ ተገልጿል። ባለስልጣኑ አገሪቱ ከሁለቱም አቅጣጫዎች የሚመጡ ጥቃቶችን ለመከላከል ዝግጁ መሆኗን ጠቁመዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Saudi Arabia gareeleen waraanaa Iraaq keessa jiran kanneen Houtii wajjin hariiroo qaban, buufataalee diinagdee fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa biyyattii irratti haleellaa raawwachuuf qophaa'aa akka jiran akeekkachiisaniiru. Haleellaan kun gargaarsa humnoota Iraan irraa argachuun, xiyyaara malee fayyadamuun karaa garaa garaa raawwatamuu akka danda'u ibsameera. Tarkaanfiin kun tattaaffii nagaa fi dippilomaasii naannichaa gufachiisuuf kan karoorfame ta'uu tu himame.

title: Tigray’s Youth are Breaking the TPLF’s Narrative Monopoly
english: For decades, the TPLF maintained strict control over Tigray’s political narrative by suppressing independent media and utilizing its own propaganda outlets. However, the rise of social media and the emergence of outspoken young activists have significantly challenged this monopoly. As the party's influence wanes, these new digital platforms are being used to hold leadership accountable and promote diverse political perspectives. This shift represents a transition away from state-enforced compliance toward a more transparent and open public discourse.
amharic: ለበርካታ አሥርታት የሕወሓት ድርጅት ነፃ ሚዲያዎችን በማፈንና የራሱን የፕሮፓጋንዳ ማሰራጫዎች በመጠቀም የትግራይን የፖለቲካ ትርክት ተቆጣጥሮ ቆይቷል። ይሁን እንጂ የማኅበራዊ ሚዲያ መስፋፋት እና በወጣቶች የሚመራው አዲስ የሐሳብ ልውውጥ ይህንን የበላይነት እየተገዳደረው ይገኛል። የድርጅቱ ተጽዕኖ እየቀነሰ በመምጣቱ፣ ዲጂታል መድረኮች አመራርን ተጠያቂ ለማድረግ እና አማራጭ የፖለቲካ ሐሳቦችን ለማንሸራሸር እየዋሉ ነው። ይህ ለውጥ ከፍርሃት እና ከአፈና የጸዳ፣ ይበልጥ ግልጽ እና ነፃ የሆነ የፖለቲካ ምህዳር የመፍጠር ምልክት ነው።
oromo: TPLF waggoota dheeraaf miidiyaalee bilisaa ukkaamsuun fi miidiyaalee isaa mataa isaa fayyadamuun odeeffannoo Tigraayirratti to'annoo cimaa godhee ture. Haa ta'u malee, fayyadama miidiyaalee hawaasaa fi ka'umsa dargaggootaa dammaqan waldorgommii siyaasaa kanatti jijjiirama fideera. Dhiibbaan party kanaa yeroo dadhabaa deemu, dhimmoota siyaasaa fi gaafatama mootummaa irratti dubbachuun iddoo guddaa argachaa jira. Kunis siyaasa soda irratti hundaa'e irraa gara yaada bilisaa fi iftoomina qabutti cehuu agarsiisa.

title: Trump denies US weapons shortage and says information 'leakers' being 'hunted down'
english: President Donald Trump has rejected claims that the United States is facing a weapons shortage during the ongoing conflict with Iran. He insisted that the nation maintains a robust supply of munitions and is actively producing more. Furthermore, the President condemned recent reports about his military’s stockpile as treasonous and stated that those responsible for leaking this classified information will face severe legal consequences.

title: Ukraine hits two oil refineries deep in Russian territory
english: Ukraine conducted long-range drone strikes against two Russian oil refineries and damaged several vessels in the Black Sea. President Zelensky stated that these attacks aim to reduce Russia's oil profits used to fund the ongoing war. Meanwhile, Russia retaliated with its own strikes, causing casualties and power outages in Ukrainian cities.

title: US Senate committee votes to hold Fauci in contempt over Covid hearing
english: A US Senate committee has voted to hold former health official Anthony Fauci in contempt of Congress for refusing to answer questions during a recent hearing. The move follows Fauci's repeated use of his right against self-incrimination, leading the committee to suggest potential prosecution. While Fauci's legal team labels the decision a political attack, lawmakers argue he must be held accountable for defying an official subpoena despite a prior federal pardon.

Faawuchi mirga ofirraa ittisuu fayyadamuun deebii kennuuf fedhii waan hin qabneef, komiteen kun gara waajjira haqaa qajeelfamee akka himataman barbaada. Gareen abukaattota Faawuchii tarkaanfiin kun siyaasaa akka ta'e dubbatanis, miseensonni senaataa garuu ajaja seeraa cabsuun itti gaafatamummaa akka qabu ibsaniiru.

title: DR Congo river boat under quarantine for Ebola after five deaths
english: Congolese authorities have quarantined a boat carrying 255 passengers on the Congo River after five people died from symptoms possibly linked to Ebola. Health officials and the WHO are currently conducting medical screenings and laboratory tests on board to prevent the virus from reaching the capital, Kinshasa. While no positive cases have been confirmed yet, the vessel remains under isolation as a precautionary measure during the ongoing Ebola outbreak.
amharic: የዲሞክራቲክ ኮንጎ ባለስልጣናት በኮንጎ ወንዝ ላይ 255 ተሳፋሪዎችን የያዘ መርከብ ከኢቦላ ጋር በተያያዘ ምልክቶች አምስት ሰዎች በመሞታቸው ለይተው አቆይተዋል። የጤና ባለሙያዎች እና የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት ቫይረሱ ወደ ዋና ከተማዋ ኪንሻሳ እንዳይገባ ለመከላከል በመርከቡ ላይ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ። እስካሁን የተረጋገጠ የኢቦላ ጉዳይ ባይኖርም መርከቧ ጥንቃቄ ለማድረግ በቁጥጥር ስር ሆና ትቆያለች።
oromo: Hojjettoonni fayyaa biyya Koongoo doonii namoota 255 featte tokko, namoonni shan mallattoo dhukkuba Iiboolaa fakkaatuun erga du'anii booda to'annoo jala oolchaniiru.
